group: Untwisted Spin x Z12, flavor commutes with fermion parity. All fermions are counted as left-handed Weyl. Singlets are neutral under the Standard Model.
scope: Ordinary unit SU(3) and SU(2) instantons, plus pure spin/discrete backgrounds. Complete multiplets for the ordinary families and two new vectorlike 5+5bar pairs; canonical non-R flavor action on all chiral superfields. No inflow or independent anomaly-cancelling sectors.
